### Mechanism of the Week: The Hallmarks of Aging
The hallmarks of aging are a set of twelve biological processes whose age-associated changes meet three criteria: they appear with advancing age, their experimental accentuation speeds aging, and their therapeutic targeting can slow, stop, or reverse aspects of aging in model systems. ### Mechanism of the Week: Cardiorespiratory Fitness and Mortality
In a UK Biobank analysis, 11,530 adults aged 40 to 73 completed two estimates of cardiorespiratory fitness on a submaximal cycle ergometer. Cardiorespiratory fitness is the capacity to take up and use oxygen in hard work. The quantity used for that capacity is maximal oxygen uptake, VO2max, reported here in millilitres per kilogram per minute.
